setup.rule: short into resistance on third bounce or front side short after 300% extension
setup.quote: my go-to play is called the shorten to resistance... I'm looking for a stock that is spiking into previous day high... once it gets close enough to that $2.50 I would like for it to have a hard crack then I would short the bounce
the other short setup that I'm looking for is called the front side short I like a stock to be extended either on the first Green Day or a multi-day runner extended at least 300%

entry.rule: short after hard crack on bounce into resistance or into strength on extension
entry.quote: I would short the bounce on that hard crack risking that $2.50 level

stop.rule: risk previous high or resistance level

exits.rule: cover on fade or at VWAP rejection
exits.quote: if it can bounce to vwap I will re short it looking for it to reject off of vwap and fade back down

sizing.rule: consistent daily risk with broker max loss
sizing.quote: having a consistent risk at a day a max daily loss at the broker level

market_filter.rule: only trade when setup matches strict criteria, avoid gappers under 300%
market_filter.quote: if my setup does not present itself I am not to initiate a trade
